sections.text: Blog > KPCA Show 2026: Meet PCBWay at Booth R310 in South Korea KPCA Show 2026: Meet PCBWay at Booth R310 in South Korea by: Mila Aug 12,2026 214 Views 0 Comments Posted in News PCBWay is excited to announce its participation in KPCA Show 2026, one of the key exhibitions for the global PCB, semiconductor substrate, and advanced packaging industries. The event will take place from September 9 to 11, 2026, at Songdo Convensia in Incheon, South Korea. During the exhibition, PCBWay will be at Booth R310, where visitors can meet our team, learn more about our PCB and electronics manufacturing capabilities, and discuss solutions for their upcoming projects.
